text:
Your shop’s journey
Your shop, over the years

Eight familiar shelves keep their places. Product displays follow signature upgrades bought this run; permanent decorations celebrate lifetime discoveries.

Phuljhari

Four display appearances

Own product · first display
Signature I · fuller shelves
Signature IV · festive display
Signature X · premium display
Decorations that stay

Six decoration stages unlock at 0, 100, 250, 500, 750 and 1,000 lifetime unique upgrades. These decorations stay after prestige. Product displays rebuild with current-run signatures.

This candidate preserves the original stall artwork. Final placement of later decoration layers can follow your review.

title: Your shop’s journey

text:
A little guidance
Start with a spark

Manually buy Phuljhari in Products. Products earn automatically; tap the counter on any main tab for extra cash.

Grow your way

Player contains tap training and the full upgrade browser. Products contains your eight families. Legacy brings together Fame and Talent. Shop contains Kaju Katli packs.

Begin again, stronger

Prestige resets the run while keeping Fame, Talent, KK, free credits, discoveries and decorations.

Back
title: A little guidance

text:
Every card has a chance
Same pool for every draw

Common · 75% / 16 cards = 4.6875% each

Rare · 22% / 10 cards = 2.2% each

Legendary · 3% / 2 cards = 1.5% each

Free draws and 100-KK draws use the same pool. Each duplicate adds one card level. There is no guaranteed rarity from buying a pack.
